_comment: Supported keypads: the single source for the udev rules, keypad-ctl and Settings > Keypad. Edit, then run gen.py (see KEYPAD.md). status: supported = has a working backend (udev grants access, tags the device for systemd and starts the backend's service; the bar shows the icon); planned = known but no backend yet (nothing happens on plug-in).
